name: Aquaguard Aspire SlimTech UV Bar
summary: The Aquaguard Slimtech UV Bar Inline Copper Water Purifier features a sleek ultra-slim glass design with advanced 7-stage UV purification for safe and healthy drinking water.
intro: The Aquaguard Slimtech UV Bar Inline Copper Water Purifier combines advanced UV purification with a premium ultra-slim glass design to deliver safe, healthy drinking water for municipal water supplies. Its 7-stage purification system, 5th Gen UV LED technology, and Patented Active Copper Technology ensure every drop is enriched with essential minerals while effectively removing bacteria, viruses, dust, dirt, and harmful chemicals. Featuring a real-time TDS display, intelligent service alerts, and a compact 21 cm slim profile, it is an ideal choice for modern kitchens seeking style, convenience, and reliable purification. Suitable for municipal water with TDS up to 200 ppm.
features: 7-Stage UV Purification – Removes bacteria, viruses, and harmful contaminants.
5th Gen UV LED – Instant purification with a long-lasting, mercury-free UV system.
Active Copper Technology – Enriches water with Copper, Magnesium, and Calcium.
Real-Time TDS Display – Shows input and purified water TDS levels.
Ultra-Slim Glass Design – Premium toughened glass finish with a sleek profile.
Advanced Smart Alerts – Filter, service, and system status notifications.
Inline Water Purifier – Continuous purified water without a storage tank.
Ideal for Municipal Water – Suitable for water with TDS up to 200 ppm.
